comparison.objective: Join shelf and cabinet panels using two cam locks.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient cams, align bolts/dowels, push panels squarely together, and turn cams with screwdriver regrasping.
comparison.success_condition: Both cams locked at least 120 degrees past open, joint gap at most 0.5 mm, tools returned, with no forced closed-cam damage.
comparison.reason: Tests staged insertion and eccentric locking; it neither fractures a sacrificial feature nor manages released fragments.
